name: ProverBench
intro: ProverBench是DeepSeek-Prover-V2论文提出的Lean 4形式化定理证明基准，共325题。其中15题从AIME 2024与2025的数论和代数题中筛选并形式化，另310题来自精选的高中竞赛与本科教材、教育教程，覆盖数论、代数、微积分、分析与概率等领域。
build_method: 筛选15道AIME 2024-2025数论与代数题，并从教材和教育教程精选、形式化310道竞赛与本科数学题
eval_feature: 以补全Lean 4代码的整段证明生成评测，支持非CoT与先给证明计划的CoT模式，并在Lean 4.9.0-rc2中形式验证
scale: 325题：15道AIME 2024-2025题与310道教材/教程题，覆盖9个数学领域
build_method_en: Select and formalize 15 number-theory and algebra problems from AIME 2024-2025, then curate and formalize 310 competition and undergraduate problems from textbooks and educational tutorials
eval_feature_en: Whole-proof Lean 4 code completion in non-CoT or proof-plan-first CoT mode, with formal verification in Lean 4.9.0-rc2
intro_en: ProverBench is a Lean 4 formal theorem-proving benchmark introduced with DeepSeek-Prover-V2. It contains 325 problems: 15 selected and formalized number-theory and algebra questions from AIME 2024-2025, plus 310 curated high-school competition and undergraduate problems from textbooks and educational tutorials across number theory, algebra, calculus, analysis, and probability.
scale_en: 325 problems: 15 from AIME 2024-2025 and 310 from textbooks or tutorials across nine mathematical areas
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按DeepSeek-Prover-V2论文、官方仓库与Hugging Face字段核对15道AIME筛选、排除几何/组合/计数、310道教材与教程题、九领域计数、325题Lean 4任务封装、非CoT/CoT提示、Lean 4.9.0-rc2验证与通过率；已移除旧图误混入的冷启动训练流程，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。
